newsitem.title: MEXICO: Looming cold front threatens Mexico, one port shut.
newsitem.headline: Looming cold front threatens Mexico, one port shut.

text.p: A cold front along the Gulf of Mexico closed one port and high winds threatened activity at others on the eastern coasts, Mexico's Communications and Transport Ministry said in an update Tuesday.
The report said winds from the north at 15 to 25 knots (28 to 47 kilometres/17 to 28 miles per hour) were causing waves between five and eight feet high.

Frontera port in Tabasco state was shut as of th 1500 local/ 2300 GMT report, and Tampico, Mezquital and Altamira in Tamaulipas state and Coatzacoalcos in Veracruz state were closed to smaller vessels, namely fishing and tourist boats.
